news_events.title: Upcoming Free Healthcare Camp
news_events.content: We are organizing a comprehensive medical check-up camp at Tadigadapa center, featuring pediatrician and general physician consultations.

news_events.title: Successful Distribution of School Kits
news_events.content: Over 200 children received school bags, notebooks, and writing materials at our education drive held last Sunday. Thank you to our donors!

ground_actions.title: Mega Health Screening & Medicine Drive
ground_actions.subtitle: Critical healthcare checkups and diagnostics in rural Vijayawada.
ground_actions.description: We successfully organized a free diagnostic healthcare camp. Over 300 individuals from rural families received general physician checkups, pediatric consultations, blood sugar diagnostics, and complimentary generic medicines. The action targeted the health issues in remote villages where access to hospitals is scarce.

ground_actions.title: Rural Women Vocational Training Program Launch
ground_actions.subtitle: Providing tools for financial self-reliance.
ground_actions.description: To empower women and enable self-reliance, we launched a vocational training drive. The training course covers fashion design, sewing machine operation, and retail bookkeeping. We also distributed 15 free sewing machines to the top performing candidates to jumpstart their home tailoring businesses.
